title: simulator-v3.0.0 AuditPayload
description: Post-game reveal delivered to submit_audit under the simulator-v3.0.0 compatibility profile. `series_consensus` is a peer extension (uoh-ay26, C-040): a post-series SHA-exchange envelope, never a game outcome -- valid only with empty records and a 64-hex consensus_sha, and it must never alter an already-completed sub-game result.

nonce.description: Per-turn commitment nonce, secret before this post-game audit reveal.
nonce.x-length-policy: Lowercase hex; no length is imposed. The book fixes no nonce format (`inst/police_thief_p2p_Summary.md` shows `secrets.token_hex(16)` in its own example code but states no requirement), and Appendix E rule 19 sanctions a mismatch between the recomputed and declared digest (`:1270`), never an unusual shape. A peer whose digest verifies is honest whatever its nonce length; refusing it scored a fair player as a forger (`C-033`).

consensus_sha.description: series_consensus only: SHA-256 over the canonical game_id, game_uid and six agreed result/role/score/winner rows.
